metadata.description: Specification-First Agentic Development — structured AI-assisted development with context persistence, specs, and decision capture.

plugins.name: spec-first
plugins.description: 9 skills and a commit gate for the Spec-First methodology: bootstrap projects, create specs in their own worktree, review specs against the code, apply them, deliver them as a pull request or a whole series as one, log decisions, sync methodology updates. The gate runs the verify stages at every spec commit.
